title: I'm making a pizza tycoon where you build every pizza and your restaurant
author: sapinhosapao
selftext:
Hi! I've been making a small pizzeria tycoon in pixel art. You put the toppings on one by one, open the doors and see if the customers like it. Later you can open more pizzerias around the city.

It's free and plays in the browser. Still a work in progress, so any feedback helps! https://aruvez.itch.io/pizza-magna

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/sapinhosapao please update this post with more on how you used AI to build the game. A line saying it was made with AI isn't enough. Share dev details. Rule 4 is there so promotional posts add to the sub by talking about the process and real development. We don't want the sub drowned in empty promotion. Posts that aren't updated may be removed.

comments.author: RUSuper
comments.body: Why is Pizza with eggs on it 100 quality? 😡😡😡

replies.author: sapinhosapao
replies.body: I understand there are some pizza disputes, i can review it later :) also working on toppings balance at the moment.

replies.author: RUSuper
replies.body: I am kidding haha, to each their own, but balancing scoring will not be easy tbh.

replies.author: sapinhosapao
replies.body: Thanks ! Be kind to give it a try

comments.author: thecrownforge
comments.body: the four customer groups sound like the interesting part of the tycoon. for the first session, could you show two orders from different groups and let the player change one topping to serve them both? that would teach why toppings matter before the player sees all 100 of them.

replies.author: sapinhosapao
replies.body: Great idea, thanks! Right now new players land on 100+ toppings with no context, and I can see in the stats that many leave before opening the doors. A first-session "two orders, one swap" challenge is a much better way to show the customer groups. Adding it to the list!
